name: plain-opus-s1-holdout2-r1-answer_shipping_zone_count-amplifier-plain-a1
final_message:
`shipping.ZONES` has 5 keys: `NA-EAST`, `NA-WEST`, `EU-CENTRAL`, `EU-NORTH` and `APAC-SE`. Importing `shipping.py` and taking the length of `ZONES` also returns 5.

I read every file in the directory. None of the others add zone codes:
- **`decoy_legacy_zones.py`** has a deprecated table (`ZONE-A` to `ZONE-D`).
- **`decoy_partner_regions.py`** lists a partner carrier's regions, which aren't zone codes.
- **`decoy_warehouse_map.py`** only reuses three codes that are already in `ZONES`.
- **`checkout.py`, `notify.py` and `.amplifier/settings.local.yaml`** contain no zone definitions.

ANSWER: 5
